targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Trading psychology for beginners: why a stop loss hit on a perfect setup is okay, and why you should follow the process, not the outcome.
Setup was perfect. Market moved opposite. SL hit. And that's OK. In intraday trading, even a perfect setup can fail, and a stop loss is simply the cost of doing business. This video is for every trader who wants to stop judging a trade by its result and start judging it by whether they followed their plan.
